```{r}
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
library(HaplotypeRainbows)
```

```{r}
create_dt <- function(x){
  DT::datatable(x,
                extensions = 'Buttons',
                options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                               buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                               lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                                 c(10,25,50,"All"))),
                filter = "top")
}

```

```{r}
seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed = readr::read_tsv("PathWeaverResults/reports/populationClustering/reports/seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed.tab.txt")


seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed_samplesGatheredPerTarget_plot = ggplot(seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed, aes(x = target, y  = nSamples)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = nSamples),
    nudge_y = 2
  ) +
  labs(y = "Total Samples")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -90, hjust = 0))


seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed_totalHapsGatheredPerTarget_plot = ggplot(seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed, aes(x = target, y  = totalHaplotypes)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = totalHaplotypes),
    nudge_y = 2
  ) +
  labs(y = "Total Haplotypes") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -90, hjust = 0))

```


```{r}
allBasicInfo = readr::read_tsv("PathWeaverResults/reports/populationClustering/reports/allBasicInfo.tab.txt.gz")

allBasicInfo = allBasicInfo |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  mutate(medianCov = median(perBaseCoverage)) |>
  mutate(covNorm = perBaseCoverage/medianCov )


allBasicInfo_sp = allBasicInfo |>
  select(sample, name, covNorm) |>
  spread(name, covNorm)

allBasicInfo_sp_mat = as.matrix(allBasicInfo_sp[,2:ncol(allBasicInfo_sp)])
rownames(allBasicInfo_sp_mat) = allBasicInfo_sp$sample
allBasicInfo_sp_mat[allBasicInfo_sp_mat > 10] = 10
allBasicInfo_sp_mat_hp = Heatmap(
  allBasicInfo_sp_mat,
  name = "Normalized Coverage",
  row_dend_width = unit(4, "cm"),
  column_dend_height  = unit(2, "cm")
)

allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp = allBasicInfo |>
  select(sample, name, perBaseCoverage) |>
  mutate(perBaseCoverage = log10(perBaseCoverage + 1)) |>
  spread(name, perBaseCoverage)

allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat = as.matrix(allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp[,2:ncol(allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp)])
rownames(allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat) = allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp$sample
allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat[allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat > 10] = 10
allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat_hp = Heatmap(
  allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat,
  name = "log10\nCoverage",
  row_dend_width = unit(4, "cm"),
  column_dend_height  = unit(2, "cm")
)
```


```{r}
targets = readr::read_tsv("regions/bed_withGeneInfo.tsv", col_names = T)
targets_aaInfo = readr::read_tsv("regions/bed_withGeneAAInfo.bed", col_names = T)

```

```{r}
div_measures = readr::read_tsv("PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/popGenetics/allDiversityMeasures.tsv.gz")
div_measures_sel = div_measures |>
  select(-expShannonEntropy, -avgPercentID, -avgNumOfDiffs, -simpleAvalance, -completeAvalance)
```


```{r}
allSelected = readr::read_tsv("PathWeaverResults/reports/populationClustering/reports/allSelectedClustersInfo.tab.txt.gz")

allSelected_prep = HaplotypeRainbows::prepForRainbow(allSelected)
allSelected_prep_sp = allSelected_prep %>%
  group_by(s_Sample, p_name) %>%
  filter(c_AveragedFrac == max(c_AveragedFrac)) %>%
  mutate(marker = 1) %>%
  group_by() %>%
  select(h_popUID, marker, s_Sample) %>%
  spread(h_popUID, marker, fill = 0)

allSelected_prep_sp_mat = as.matrix(allSelected_prep_sp[,2:ncol(allSelected_prep_sp)])
rownames(allSelected_prep_sp_mat) = allSelected_prep_sp$s_Sample
allSelected_prep_sp_dist = dist(allSelected_prep_sp_mat)
allSelected_prep_sp_dist_hclust = hclust(allSelected_prep_sp_dist, method = "ward.D2")

#rename the levels so they are in the order of the clustering
allSelected_prep = allSelected_prep %>%
  mutate(s_Sample = factor(s_Sample, levels = rownames(allSelected_prep_sp_mat)[allSelected_prep_sp_dist_hclust$order]))

allSelected_plot = HaplotypeRainbows::genRainbowHapPlotObj(allSelected_prep)
allSelected_plot = allSelected_plot +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:n_distinct(allSelected_prep$p_name),
    labels = levels(allSelected_prep$p_name)
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -90, hjust = 0))
```
